hypothesis: One common per-window RMS divisor preserves relative channel energy, prevents gain-dependent collapse, and retains the frozen baseline's cross-person performance.
falsification: Do not continue to runtime promotion if clean mean person BA drops by more than 0.01, its paired 95% lower difference is at most -0.03, or compressed-input labels fail the predeclared agreement threshold. Do not call numerical invariance alone a recognition improvement.
folds: Reuse all30 frozen target/26 fitting/3 source-validation person splits verbatim, all3 seeds42/43/44

methods.baseline: Reuse original C2_EEGNet_SMALL checkpoints and later-trial predictions; independently recompute clean predictions before stress scoring
methods.candidate: Same EEGNet, optimizer, max200 epochs, patience20, source-validation early stopping and seeds; only shared RMS before fitting-only channel standardization differs

preprocessing: Original fixed8 CAR, causal512to250 FIR, notch50,1-45,8-30, completed500sample window unchanged
transform: u[n,c,t]=x[n,c,t]/sqrt(mean_{c,t}(x[n,c,t]^2)); exactly one positive divisor per window, no per-channel unit-variance scaling and no cue-dependent processing
transform_floor: Reject nonfinite or RMS<=1e-12; do not clip or impute. Physical-unit SQI remains outside this transform and unchanged.
fit_standardization: Compute channel mean/std on RMS-normalized fitting people only; freeze for source validation and outer target; shared NumPy transform rounds to FP32 only at the existing normalized_tensor boundary
target_scoring: Score original-order>=60 only (4280 target windows); first60 remain unscored despite no target adaptation
bad_trial_policy: Retain all6080 complete finite windows and all author flags; no rejected test windows removed from the denominator
stress_scope: Scalar numerical-domain counterfactual, not a physical corruption simulator or true-person accuracy test
primary_metric: Mean30 person BA, each person's mean over3 seeds; compare paired candidate-minus-baseline
secondary_metrics: left-output fraction and complete confusion matrices
improvement_claim_gate: Exploratory clean improvement only if paired95 difference lower>0; neither gate authorizes formal deployment or independent-confirmation claims
checkpoint_freeze: Finish and hash all90 candidate checkpoints before outer-target evaluation; do not change formula, epochs, seeds or target list after outer scores

runtime_choice.selection: Fixed for numerical compatibility probes before any new score, never chosen for high live or target accuracy

live_probe_policy: After all checkpoints freeze, use seven saved real windows only as label-blind numerical/gain probes; do not load cue intentions, calculate accuracy or select checkpoint from their responses
limitations: Original30 are development people, not a fresh independent test
Source MAT physical unit remains unresolved
Gain-invariance does not prove user imagery discrimination
No raw SQI or acquisition gate change
No permanent ARM or PL deployment
